import sys,unittest,json,hashlib,subprocess,datetime; from pathlib import Path; sys.path.insert(0,"tools"); from shallow_patch_fingerprints import generate,validate; r=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.TestSuite(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromName(n) for n in ("test_patch_fingerprints","test_6_6_gate_integration"))); assert r.wasSuccessful(); previous=json.loads(Path("research/shallow-review-stage/checkpoint.json").read_text()); inv=Path("research/shallow-inventory-stage/inventory.json").read_bytes(); queue=Path("research/shallow-review-stage/queue.json").read_bytes(); args=(inv,queue,previous["inventory_sha256"],previous["queue_sha256"],Path("downloads/history-probe-73e35d6/fork")); raw=generate(*args); assert validate(raw,*args)==raw; root=Path("research/shallow-fingerprint-stage"); (root/"fingerprints.json").write_bytes(raw); data=json.loads(raw); out={"created_utc":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),"baseline":"4186999","tests_passed":r.testsRun,"success_count":data["success_count"],"null_reason_counts":data["null_reason_counts"],"fingerprints_sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),"eligible":False,"preflight":{},"preservation":[],"hardware_tested":False,"next":"Missing local blob content cannot be replaced with tree/subject guesses; no upstream matching or carry decisions yet","quota":"Realtime unavailable; user snapshot 73%/51%; no precise control claim"}; exec("for e in previous["preservation"]:
 assert hashlib.sha256(Path(e["path"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==e["sha256"]
 out["preservation"].append(e)
for p in ("research/shallow-review-stage/queue.json","tools/shallow_review_queue.py"):
 b=Path(p).read_bytes()
 assert b==subprocess.check_output(["git","show","4186999:"+p])
 out["preservation"].append({"path":p,"sha256":hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),"unchanged":True})
for t in ("ci_kernel_66_probe.py","ci_allocator_implementation.py"):
 x=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"tools/"+t,"--preflight"],capture_output=True)
 assert x.returncode==2
 out["preflight"][t]=x.returncode"); (root/"checkpoint.json").write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+"
"); print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
action: 检查4186999工作区和清单/队列；新增本地单父补丁指纹，禁自动补取。修正首次测试发现unified参数令numstat混入补丁的问题，固定分离统计参数后复测。
outcome: 四项合成指纹测试与三项门禁测试通过；实际缺blob则objects_unavailable、浅边界不生成差分指纹，不下载补齐；输入哈希/规范参数/未审状态保存。
failure_note: 复测或对象审计失败，保存日志，不给伪指纹。
next_step: 保存指纹成功/缺失原因统计与断点，同步后暂停，不联网/更新。
